class: Generic labels lose the identity of their subject or date
symptom: Waystar self-identification Name received the university name, and date components reused an older value of 6.
root_cause: SCHOOL_UNIVERSITY matched bare Name without an education container. Historical answer lookup accepted context-free Month, Day, and Year labels.
why_tests_missed: Coverage tested explicit personal and school labels and complete dates, not generic labels on a later application step.
fix: Treat bare Name as personal unless education context identifies a school. Resolve repeated-entry dates first, then refuse historical lookup for unqualified numeric date-part labels.
prevention: Require subject and date context for generic labels rather than transporting answers by label alone.
